title: So much fun for me!
text: I really like the pixie skin treats oil. It smells great and it feels good I really like it a lot I put it on before I go to bed and it smells wonderful. The highlighter is nice also. I have not tried the mask or the soap. The serum is nice but so small it doesn’t really give you a chance to try it very well and find out what it is
label: positive
